newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Roche rebounds after weak start.
newsitem.headline: Roche rebounds after weak start.

text.p: Certificates of Roche Holding AG opened slightly weaker, but quickly rebounded and gained after reporting a 10 percent rise in first-half group net profit.
In pre-bourse trade, Roche non-voting equity securities, or certificates, had been under pressure and dealers said there was some disappointment over the result, noting selling from abroad.
Immediately after the opening of the Swiss Exchange, Roche certificates were down by up to 35 francs.
But by 0815 GMT Roche's certificates had reversed course and were up 105 francs at 1,3495 Swiss francs, 0.8 percent, and continued to move upwards.
